subject: AtlasHealth: Hosted API expansion for new product lines
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: J. Morales <jmorales@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring pricing for additional product workloads

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're moving ahead with two additional product teams that will use the Hosted API: Clinical Summaries (high token volume) and Patient Insights (medium volume, many short requests). The finance team asked us to get a clear pricing path if we add these workloads over the next 6 months.

Can you send a simple breakdown for:
- Per-token pricing with volume tiers for hosted usage
- How incremental commit top-ups would apply (if we keep a base commit for core product)
- Any bundled discounts for multi-product rollouts or seat-based add-ons

We're especially focused on: predictability for budgeting, avoiding overcommitment, and a path to modest discounts once we pass volume thresholds.

Also copying procurement to start the PO conversation if numbers look good.

Appreciate it,
Aisha
Senior PM, AtlasHealth

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring pricing for additional product workloads

Hi Aisha —

Great to hear you're expanding. I've put together a concise proposal that tries to balance predictability and flexibility for AtlasHealth. Summary attached (pricing_summary_v2.xlsx) and SOW addendum for the expansion (SOW_addendum_AtlasHealth.pdf). Key points below — happy to hop on a call to walk through numbers next week.

Proposal highlights:
- Base commit (existing product): keep as-is, no change to current billing.
- Expansion workload path: incremental monthly commit credits that top up hosted usage for new product teams. Top-ups billed at a blended per-token rate that gets cheaper as cumulative monthly tokens increase.

Example (monthly committed tokens / blended rate):
- 0–250M tokens: $0.00008 per token (no discount)
- 250M–1B tokens: $0.000068 per token (15% discount on incremental usage)
- 1B–2.5B tokens: $0.000056 per token (30% discount on incremental usage)

Mechanics:
- You can keep a single invoice with line-items for each product/team; top-ups are purchased as monthly commitments that auto-apply to that product's usage first.
- Unused committed tokens roll into a 30-day buffer for other Atlas products on the same bill.
- If you prefer no upfront commit, we offer a non-committed overage rate but it is ~25% higher.

Discounting & packaging for new teams:
- For +2 additional teams within 6 months, we propose a multi-team addendum: additional 5% on top of the tiered discounts for the first 6 months post-onboarding (applies when combined incremental tokens exceed 300M/month).
- For multi-product rollouts with >12 months term, we can provide a ramp schedule on monthly commit pricing to protect you from early overcommit.

Next steps suggested:
1) Confirm approximate monthly token forecast per new product (ballpark numbers are fine).
2) Decide whether you want top-ups as monthly commitments or prefer pay-as-you-go to start (we can propose a hybrid).
3) If procurement is comfortable, we'll send a short addendum + DocuSign link.

I've looped in Marcus for approval on the extra add-on discount and Lauren for the billing mechanics.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwood.com)

Attachments: pricing_summary_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_addendum_AtlasHealth.pdf (draft)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring pricing for additional product workloads

Hannah —

Reviewed the numbers. The tier bands look defensible; comfortable approving the 5% temporary add-on for multi-team rollouts as a short-term incentive (6 months). Two notes:
1) For any discount stacking, we need a hard floor of 30% off list for hosted API across the combined incremental tiers (to protect margin).
2) Ask finance (Lauren) to confirm the 30-day unused-token buffer mechanics and whether we need language about long tails after termination.

Connor — if Atlas pushes for contract-level term changes (SLA credits, extended data retention), flag early; we may want to route that to Solutions/Legal.

-Marcus

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@atlashealth.com>, J. Morales <jmorales@atlashealth.com>, procure@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-03-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring pricing for additional product workloads

Thanks —

Quick clarifications from billing:
- The 30-day buffer will allow cross-product crediting for unused committed tokens on the same invoice; after 30 days, leftover committed tokens expire. We'll add explicit language in the SOW addendum.
- We can accept a PO referencing the SOW_addendum_AtlasHealth.pdf. Please include the HubSpot deal id in the PO.
- Billing contact for Atlas should be a single email to avoid duplicate invoices. If procurement will be issuing the PO, please confirm the billing contact and the mailing address for invoices.

Hannah, once Aisha confirms estimates per product, we'll generate the DocuSign addendum and a one-page billing summary.

Lauren Bishop
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: J. Morales <jmorales@atlashealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: procure@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-03-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring pricing for additional product workloads

Hannah / Lauren / Marcus —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We ran internal forecasting: Clinical Summaries ~600M tokens/month after ramp; Patient Insights ~120M tokens/month. We'll start with monthly top-ups for each product and re-evaluate once Clinical Summaries stabilizes.

Procurement will issue a PO referencing the SOW_addendum_AtlasHealth.pdf and the HubSpot deal id. Can you send the DocuSign link and a final one-page billing summary (line items for the base commit and the two top-ups)? Also confirm the blended per-token rate that will apply in month 1 given our combined incremental monthly tokens (~720M).

On a final note: do the 6-month multi-team add-on (5%) and the tier discounts stack? If so, please show both applied in the billing summary.

--J. Morales
Director of Product Operations, AtlasHealth
